exposure: Artificial placenta (AP) utilizing extracorporeal life support (ECLS)
outcome: Lung development (area fraction of double-positive tips of secondary alveolar septa)
cohort: Preterm lambs at an estimated gestational age (EGA) of 114-128 days (term = 145 days), delivered by Caesarian section.
finding: The artificial placenta is protective against lung injury and promotes lung development compared with mechanical ventilation in premature lambs.
